name: OVHcloud AI Endpoints
description: Calls hosted LLM, embedding, speech-to-text and image models through OpenAI-compatible serverless APIs hosted in Europe by OVHcloud, for developers who need EU data protection.

skills.name: Chat and Responses
skills.description: Generates text, code and reasoning with hosted LLMs through OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions and Responses APIs.

skills.name: Speech to Text
skills.description: Transcribes audio files to text with hosted speech recognition models through the OpenAI-compatible audio API.

skills.name: Function Calling and Structured Output
skills.description: Calls developer-defined functions and returns JSON that matches a schema you set, using function calling and structured outputs.

skills.name: Batch Mode
skills.description: Runs large volumes of inference requests asynchronously through the OpenAI-compatible Batch API, with no infrastructure to manage.

skills.name: Catalog API
skills.description: Lists available AI Endpoints models with their supported features, pricing and metadata through the public Catalog API.
